critical_code_review_comments: platformCardInvoice.js:114 — invoiceNo fallback `CARD-${sale.id.slice(0,6).toUpperCase()}` uses the FIRST 6 hex chars of the sale UUID. With high sale volume per tenant this 6-hex space (16M) has a measurable birthday collision risk for customer-facing invoice numbers; recommend using a tenant-monotonic counter or the full sale id (or a 8-char base32) for the invoice_number when not provided by the backend.

platformCardInvoice.js:86 — the inline `<script>window.onload=function(){window.print();setTimeout(function(){window.close()},500)}</script>` runs unconditionally inside the popup. Modern browsers (esp. with popup blockers + cross-origin restrictions) can silently swallow the popup; consider adding a fallback in-page 'Click to Print' button rendered server-less inside the body so users on a blocked popup still see something printable.

platformCardInvoice.js:64 — denomination uses `_fmtAmount(denomination)` which is ar-DZ locale (Arabic-Indic digits or DZD spacing). For thermal 58mm where horizontal real-estate is precious, the long ar-DZ format may wrap to a second line. Consider passing a {style:'decimal', useGrouping:false} option or a tighter formatter for thermal58 only.

SellPlatformCardDialog.js:145-151 — three print buttons rendered with distinct testids but the file imports printPlatformCardInvoice which calls window.open(...,_blank,...). In some embedded POS browsers (e.g. Android Chrome WebView) window.open without a user-gesture context returns null. The handler at line ~112 returns the boolean ok but the UI does not surface a toast on `ok===false` (popup blocked). Recommend a toast.error('فضلاً اسمح بالنوافذ المنبثقة للطباعة') when printPlatformCardInvoice returns false.

audit_timeline_routes.py:26-37 (carried review) — the iter-13 _parse_iso coercion to UTC is solid for the regression, but the function silently drops timezone-aware inputs that supply a different offset (e.g. +02:00). Confirm tests cover both naive and offset-bearing inputs — current iter-14 pytest only exercises the naive path.
